description: This file defines a WorldMap React component that renders an interactive world map with bubbles and geographies, using D3 and Datamaps. It handles data processing, color schemes, event handling, and map updates.

classes.name: WorldMapProps
classes.description: TypeScript interface defining the properties accepted by the WorldMap component.

classes.name: WorldMapDataEntry
classes.description: Interface representing individual data entries for countries on the map.

classes.name: ProcessedDataEntry
classes.description: Extended data entry including visual properties like radius and fillColor.

classes.name: WorldMapFilterState
classes.description: Interface for the filter state used in the map component.

classes.name: DatamapSource
classes.description: Interface for data source identifiers used in event handlers.

methods.name: WorldMap
methods.description: Main function component that initializes and renders the interactive world map, handling data processing, event binding, and map updates.
